summary: Verified two one-line bug fixes: (1) Home.jsx useEffect eslint-disable comment — CI=true yarn build compiled cleanly with zero errors/warnings on Home.jsx. (2) deploy.sh nginx reload block — bash -n parses OK, and the block now uses `systemctl list-unit-files | grep -qE '^nginx(\.service)?\s'` (matches both nginx and nginx.service), falls back to `nginx -s reload` when the binary exists, and prints a clear warning otherwise. Regression: 12/12 gohub_client tests pass, /api/health returns {status:ok}, admin login → /admin → gohub-test tab renders with [data-testid=gohub-test-tab] and [data-testid=gh-run] button; clicking Run TBS Probe returned a SOAP trace containing 'Invalid Server IP' (live path — GOHUB_ENABLED is true in current env; either dry_run or Invalid Server IP is acceptable per brief). Homepage loads, no page/console errors, and the '🏙 Kuala Lumpur · Any stop · 4 options' city-level pseudo-option is selectable in the From terminal picker.

verification_details.bug1_ci_build: cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build → Compiled successfully. Exit 0. No 'React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency' error on Home.jsx.
verification_details.bug2_deploy_sh: bash -n /app/scripts/deploy.sh → exit 0. Lines 90-98 confirmed: systemctl regex match ^nginx(\.service)?\s → sudo systemctl reload nginx; elif command -v nginx → sudo nginx -s reload; else warn clearly.

critical_code_review_comments: The eslint-disable-next-line comment sits on line 158 immediately before the `}, []);` — CRA/react-scripts will honour it (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is enabled by default). Emergent's config disables that rule and reports 'unused directive' as a warning; this is harmless per the request note.
deploy.sh nginx block is robust: systemctl → nginx -s reload → warn. Good.

Note: GOHUB_ENABLED appears to be true in the current preview env (probe returned live 'Invalid Server IP' rather than dry_run). Both are acceptable per brief; flagging so main agent is aware if they want to reset it before handoff.
